extDescription.message: Syncs your FC 27 Ultimate Team club to FC-Tracker for the best Gallery selection, first owner and the cards to buy next.

enterCode.message: Enter the code shown in the FC-Tracker app:

badgeNoApp.message: FC-Tracker: the app is not running or not connected

badgeNotPaired.message: FC-Tracker: not connected – click the extension icon

badgeWaiting.message: FC-Tracker: waiting for the Web App …

badgeError.message: FC-Tracker: the sync stopped ($ERROR$) – reload the Web App to try again.

bgNoResponse.message: The extension background is not responding – reload the extension

badgeAborted.message: FC-Tracker: you entered Ultimate Team – sync stopped, closing the Web App

badgeSaved.message: FC-Tracker: saved ✓ – the app picks it up the next time it runs

badgeAppClosed.message: FC-Tracker: the app is closed – your sync is saved. Open the app for the best sync

badgeSignIn.message: FC-Tracker – action needed: sign in to the Web App – the sync then starts by itself.

badgeNotReady.message: FC-Tracker – action needed: the Web App did not load your club. Check you are signed in, then reload this page.

updateInstalling.message: Update found – installing, the extension restarts in a moment.

updateRollingOut.message: The Chrome Web Store hasn't delivered it yet – it installs by itself, usually within a day.

upToDateChecked.message: No update – you have the newest version.

updateThrottled.message: Chrome allows the next check in a few minutes – try again then.

updateFailed.message: The check didn't work – try again in a moment.

updateManual.message: Installed from the .zip: download the new one, replace the folder, then press Reload in chrome://extensions.

badgeWebSynced.message: FC-Tracker: club synced ✓ – back to FC-Tracker Web

openFailed.message: FC-Tracker didn't open – is it installed on this PC? Get it at fc-tracker.com/download.

badgeNamesMissing.message: FC-Tracker: synced – but EA's Web App showed $COUNT$ players without a name. Close other Web App tabs, reload this one and sync again.

v2_extension.description: Marker: the keys after this one belong to the v2-extension session (brand v2, account, no sync without an owner).

subAppClosed.message: Your sync is kept here and handed to the app the next time it runs.

subAccount.message: Open the Web App – your club syncs to your FC-Tracker account by itself.

subAccountPending.message: Your last sync is waiting for the account – it is sent again within a minute.

subNone.message: Sign in below, or get the app – then your club syncs by itself.

subNoneApp.message: Connect the app or sign in – then your club syncs by itself.

accountViaApp.message: The app keeps your club on $EMAIL$.

accountAppKeeps.message: Your club goes to the app, and the app keeps it on its account.

accountAppSignedOut.message: The app isn't signed in – your club stays on this PC. Sign in in the app to keep it on your account.

accountAppLocal.message: Your club goes to the FC-Tracker app on this PC.

signInWhy.message: No app on this PC? Sign in with your e-mail and your club sync is kept on your FC-Tracker account. No password – we send a code.

codeSentTo.message: We sent a 6-digit code to $EMAIL$. It works for 10 minutes.

authError_code_invalid.message: Wrong code – check the e-mail and try again.

authError_code_expired.message: The code has expired – send a new one.

authError_rate_limited.message: Too many tries – wait a minute and try again.

authError_offline.message: No connection to FC-Tracker – check your internet.

authError_mail_failed.message: The e-mail couldn't be sent – try again in a moment.

authError_server.message: FC-Tracker's server didn't answer – try again in a moment.

authError_signed_out.message: You were signed out – sign in again.

badgeNoOwner.message: Sign in to FC-Tracker or get the app – then your club syncs by itself.

badgePushing.message: Saving your club to your account …

badgePushed.message: Saved to your account ✓ · $COUNT$ Gallery cards

badgePushFailed.message: Your account couldn't be reached – the sync is kept and sent again within a minute.

badgeSignedOut.message: You were signed out – click the FC-Tracker icon and sign in again.
